title: Chapter Metadata Schema
description: Schema for validating chapter front matter and metadata in the AI-Humanoid-Robotics book.

module_id.description: Identifier of the module this chapter belongs to.

short_description.description: A brief summary of the chapter content.

created_date.description: The date the chapter was first created (YYYY-MM-DD).

last_updated_date.description: The date the chapter was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

authors.description: List of authors for the chapter.

keywords.description: Keywords relevant to the chapter content.

learning_outcomes.description: Measurable learning objectives for the chapter.

mini_project_id.description: Optional ID of a mini-project associated with the chapter.

sections.description: Outline of main sections within the chapter.
